name: OpenWorkbook
label: Open Excel Workbook
discription: Opens an existing Excel workbook from the specified file path and reports success or failure.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full path to the Excel file (.xlsx or .xls) that needs to be opened.

fields.name: Visible
fields.label: Visible
fields.description: Set to true if you want the Excel application to be visible during automation.

fields.name: OpenAsReadOnly
fields.label: Open as ReadOnly
fields.description: If true, opens the workbook in read-only mode.

fields.name: ReadProtectionPassword
fields.label: Read Protection Password
fields.description: Password to open the workbook if it is protected.

fields.name: ExcelApp
fields.label: Excel Application
fields.description: The Excel Application instance (used for later operations or close).
